## Acknowledgements {-}
Canadian Wildlife Federation recognizes that the lands and waters that form the basis of this plan are the traditional unceded territory of the Nuxalk and Ulkatcho First Nations. Plan development and implementation was funded by the B.C. Salmon Restoration and Innovation Fund. Members of the planning team ([Appendix B](content/appendix-b.qmd)) are passionate about the conservation and restoration of freshwater ecosystems and the species they support, and contributed feedback, guidance, and knowledge. Model outputs were further refined based on feedback provided by local knowledge holders beyond the planning team. Accessibility models were inspired by fish-passage prioritization approaches developed by British Columbia’s Fish Passage Technical Working Group.
